description: ISA-95 Part 2/4 MaterialLot (B2MML MaterialLot). Full text: docs/history/standard/profiles/material/material-lot.md, description.

properties.name: material_lot_no
properties.description: Identity of the material lot (join key). Often kept in the ERP as 'Charge/batch number' — here correctly as MaterialLot.

properties.name: article_ref
properties.description: FK to Article.article_no (DEFINED_BY) = MaterialLot.MaterialDefinitionID. The MaterialDefinition of this lot.

properties.name: article_revision
properties.description: The revision of the article that was built or used, where the source's article number carries none (a PLM part number with revision A). Empty when the number itself names the revision (at SAP dddd.1).

properties.name: status
properties.description: Lot status (ISA-95 MaterialLotProperty / Status), e.g. available, in_production, consumed, blocked.

properties.name: workorder_ref
properties.description: FK to Workorder.workorder_no, reached via JobOrder REQUIRES_MATERIAL. The order slot that produced this lot.

refStatus.reason: The reference is kept as a value: core 2.0.0 has no edge for it yet.

properties.name: job_order_ref
properties.description: FK to JobOrder.job_order_no: the job (one workorder operation) that produced this lot. Full text: docs/history/standard/profiles/material/material-lot.md, attributes › job_order_ref › description.

refStatus.reason: The reference is kept as a value: core 2.0.0 has no edge for it yet.

properties.name: location_ref
properties.description: FK to StorageLocation (AT_LOCATION). Current storage location of the lot.

properties.name: updated_at
properties.description: Last change of the lot; every writer sets it. Cursor of GET /material-lots?updated_since= (sim-v5, Welle 12).

properties.name: assembly_type
properties.description: ISA-95 AssemblyType: Physical (the parts are physically joined) or Logical (a grouping, e.g. a compound of polymer and filler).

properties.name: assembly_relationship
properties.description: ISA-95 AssemblyRelationship: Permanent (cannot be taken apart again) or Transient (temporary, e.g. a kit).

properties.name: quant_ref
properties.description: The Quant (ASSEMBLED_FROM; ISA-95 MaterialLot → MaterialSubLot). Optional.

properties.name: test_specification_ref
properties.description: The TestSpecification (TESTED_BY; ISA-95 MaterialLot → TestSpecification). Optional.

relationships.description: The material sublots (Quant) of this lot, ISA-95 Part 2 cl. 5.7 (B2MML MaterialLot.MaterialSubLot): fed from the sublot side, its lot (Quant.lot = B2MML MaterialSubLot.MaterialLotID, the back reference), source edge direction in.
Where the material is held (B2MML MaterialLot.StorageLocation).
The lots this lot is assembled from (B2MML MaterialLot.AssemblyLot, ISA-95 Part 2 cl. 5.7), e.g. a mixed lot from its component lots; one edge per component, delivered by the source.

isa95.note: ISA-95 MaterialLot = identifiable material quantity of a MaterialDefinition. RULE: ERP 'batch' == MaterialLot, NEVER an activity. Sits between Article (MaterialDefinition) and Quant (MaterialSublot). Full text: docs/history/standard/profiles/material/material-lot.md, isa95 › note.
isa95.mappingNote: B2MML MaterialLot names no producing order or job (the job names the lot through its material actual), and created_at / updated_at are technical timestamps of the source. PLM as-built (owner 29.10.2026): article_revision names the state that was built where the source's id carries none; B2MML references a definition by its ID alone (an ID means one state), so there is no field for it — an extension, never part of the key.
